title: Voice input
missed: Didn't catch that. Tap to try again

access.title: Microphone needed
access.message: To say your exercises, Loqqa needs the microphone and speech recognition. You can also type them.

unavailable.title: Voice input unavailable
unavailable.message: Your phone can't turn speech into text right now. You can type your exercises instead.

network.title: No connection
network.message: Speech recognition needs the internet. Check your connection and try again, or type your exercises.

failed.title: Couldn't add the exercises
failed.message: Please try again. Naming each exercise with its sets and reps helps.

offline.title: No connection
offline.message: Adding exercises by voice needs the internet. Check your connection and try again.

limit.title: Daily limit reached
limit.message: You can add exercises by voice again tomorrow. Until then, add them with +.

noExercises.title: No exercises heard
noExercises.message: Name each exercise with its sets and reps, like “bench press, three by ten”.
